newsitem.title: GERMANY: Homeless Christmas Eve baby dies in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Homeless Christmas Eve baby dies in Germany.

text.p: A baby boy born on Christmas Eve froze to death while his homeless mother wandered through the German city of Goettingen looking for a warm place to stay, police said on Wednesday.
Wrapped in a blanket, the boy was cold and lifeless when his mother, 28, finally reached a homeless shelter to escape the icy night, a spokesman said.
She had given birth only hours earlier in a deserted house in the central German university city and the boy at first seemed healthy, she told police.
A doctor who hurried to the shelter could only pronounce the infant dead and determine there were no signs of any violence on the corpse, the spokesman said.
